newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London mixed, quiet ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London mixed, quiet ahead of data.

text.p: U.S. shares in London were mixed in cautious trade on Thursday ahead of an onslaught of U.S. economic indicators, culminating in the October payrolls report tomorrow, traders said.
"There's no real trend today, its very quiet," one trader said. "But the bonds and futures are looking a little bit brighter, indicating a slightly better opening in New York."

S&P 500 futures were trading up 0.7 points at 703.50 by 1125 GMT, on globex. The Dow ended 13.79 points lower at 5,993.23 on Wednesday after an unsteady session in which investors focused on the impact of decelerating growth on corporate profits.
Semiconductor stocks benefited from positive comment on prospects for future growth in chip sales.
Intel put on $1/4 to $107, IBM was up $1/4 at $126-5/8 and Digital Equipment Corp was $1/4 better at $29.
Elsewhere, traders said a broker recommendation on gold shares had helped create interest in some of the mining stocks.
"Homestake was the most favoured," one dealer said.
Homestake Mining had put on $1/4 to $14-5/8.
